# Meringue Suisse

> Swiss meringues handcrafted in Temecula, California (cottage food, made in a home kitchen, Riverside County). Website: https://meringuesuisse.com

- Product: PETITES, a kraft gift box of 9 Swiss meringues, $14.90. Flavors: Classic, Coffee, Chocolate.
- Ingredients: sugar, egg whites, baking powder (+ cocoa powder for Chocolate, freeze-dried coffee for Coffee). Contains: egg. Net Wt. 1.59 oz (45 g).
- Delivery: free local delivery to the door in Temecula, Murrieta, Wildomar and French Valley (ZIP 92590-92593, 92562-92564, 92595, 92596). Shipping in California with USPS Ground Advantage: $9.90 (1-2 boxes), $12.90 (3-4), $14.90 (5-7), free from 8 boxes.
- Timing: made to order, 3-5 business days to prepare; ships Monday to Wednesday; USPS transit usually 2-5 business days.
- Storage: cool, dry place in the original box; best within 10 days.
- Ordering status: permit pending; join the waiting list at https://meringuesuisse.com/shop
- Contact: hello@meringuesuisse.com
